identityAssociations.locator: Opening overview and What term is best to use?
identityAssociations.scope: Both imported names are broad Australian labels, not identified states. Their mainland coverage and successive intervals were inspected. A shared overview names local examples and explicitly rejects a uniform society; it does not merge the individual peoples represented elsewhere.
identityAssociations.geometryCheck: Location checked in imported features only; some later coverage includes Tasmania or shrinks to western Australia. Polygons and intervals remain unchanged and unverified. The unsupported From Indus Valley alias is removed through the override.
